description: FIN Average MPG and Fuel Usage is a dataset listed in Pierce County open data portal (internal.open.piercecountywa.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Pierce County. This dataset includes total fuel usage data for the County fleet, including the Finance and ESD managed fleet vehicles. It also includes Ferry fuel usage and data on transit trips based on ORCA card usage. Coverage: Pierce County, Washington. The portal files it under the category Finance. Its tags are mpg, orca, light duty fleet, fleet. The table has 50 columns. Attribution on the portal: Finance. The portal shows 2024-02-28 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is see the terms of use on the portal (no named licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-internal-open-piercecountywa-gov-portal.
